patterns: APPSC asks one-line 'borrowed from which country' items: concurrent list = Australia, RS election = South Africa, cabinet system/bicameralism/single citizenship = Britain.
'Which is NOT correct' list items (amendment from France = wrong; South Africa is right) recur.
Federal system from GoI Act 1935 is a favourite APPSC Group-2 fact.
DPSP = Ireland, FRs = USA, federation with strong Centre = Canada dominate other PSCs.
App MCQs match the shapes well; they add more A/R and 'how many' items and the Weimar vs 1935 emergency nuance.
